title: Mutation-Site ESMC Stacking, ConFit LoRA Preference Tuning, and Expanded Post-Cutoff MaveDB Suite
models_tested: Qwen/Qwen3-14B (zero-spend open-weight BF16 pilot, direct mode)
Claude Mythos 5.2 (reference from FLIP2 ICL experiment)
Claude Fable 5.2 (reference from FLIP2 API experiment)
plm_baselines: ESMC-600M & ESMC-6B mutation-site local pooling + zero-shot ridge
ESMC-600M & ESMC-6B 5-fold out-of-fold multi-view stacked ridge (mean + mutsite + one-hot + zero-shot)
ConFit-style KL-anchored LoRA preference-tuned ESMC-300M & ESMC-600M
ESM-2 650M, ESMC-300M/600M/6B zero-shot and mean-pooled ridges
code_and_data_released: Full code, Docker entrypoint, pinned model revisions, negative controls, and paired-bootstrap tables in repository.

methods.datasets: Identical 16 FLIP2 splits + 2 FGFR2 splits (k=256, seed 0) plus 6 new post-June-2026 MaveDB splits across two unrelated human protein families: GBA1 GCase activity (urn:mavedb:00001327-a-1, 2026-11-11, 536 aa, 9,886 missense), ARAF kinase activity (urn:mavedb:00001314-0-4, 2026-10-16, 606 aa, 10,955 missense), and ARAF abundance (urn:mavedb:00001314-0-3, 2026-10-16, 606 aa, 5,037 missense). Max ungapped window identity <= 12.5% between post-cutoff families and <= 16.7% against FLIP2.
methods.evaluation_protocol: All models fit strictly on the 256 context rows with no test peeking. Track 1A combines frozen mean embeddings with zero-shot scores; Track 1B extracts mutated-site hidden states (h_mut[M], h_mut[M] - h_wt[M]) and fits 5-fold out-of-fold stacked multi-view ridges; Track 1C attaches rank-8 zero-initialized LoRA adapters to ESMC attention layers and trains 15 epochs with Bradley-Terry ranking loss + KL=0.1 anchor to frozen logits.
methods.controls_included: Shuffled-label negative controls for fusion, mutsite, stacked ridge (+0.009 to +0.011 on FLIP2; -0.077 to -0.042 on post-cutoff), and ConFit LoRA (drops -0.13 to -0.24 below real labels); epoch-0 ConFit parity verified to 0.0002 against zero-shot masked marginals; PRKN pre-cutoff upload explicitly audited and rejected.
methods.compute_and_tools: Ran inside pinned Docker image general_models_vs_plms:cu128-20261121 on oracle_gh200 (1x GH200); zero paid API spend.
methods.metrics: Mean Spearman correlation with 95% paired bootstrap intervals (2,000 draws) on exact first 100 queries (vs Mythos 5.2) and all 300 queries (vs frozen ridges and Fable 5.2).
methods.wet_lab_protocol: None (computational evaluation on primary MaveDB / FLIP2 experimental assays).

key_results.benchmark: FLIP2 (16 splits, k=256, exact first 100 queries)
key_results.baseline_model: Pure frozen ESMC-600M + ESMC-6B mutation-site+ZS ensemble (single ESMC-600M: 0.4288)
key_results.notes: Breaks the prior FLIP2 tie strictly in favor of pLMs without any LLM or fine-tuning. Shuffled-label controls score +0.0093 to +0.0107. On all 300 queries the pure frozen pLM ensemble reaches 0.4380 vs 0.3554 old ridge and 0.3649 Claude Fable 5.2.

key_results.benchmark: FLIP2 (16 splits, k=256, exact first 100 queries)
key_results.llm_model: Equal-weight rank average (Claude Mythos 5.2 + mutsite+ZS ESMC-600M)
key_results.baseline_model: Claude Mythos 5.2 alone (0.3800) / prior hybrid record (0.443)
key_results.baseline_score: +0.0867 (+0.0580 to +0.1129) over Mythos alone; +0.1000 over old ridge
key_results.notes: Confirms strong complementarity between LLM reasoning and improved local pLM representations, raising the hybrid ceiling from 0.443 to 0.467.

key_results.benchmark: Expanded post-June-2026 MaveDB suite (6 splits: GBA1, ARAF activity, ARAF abundance; q300)
key_results.notes: On single-site post-cutoff DMS, ConFit LoRA ESMC gains +0.053 to +0.065 over zero-shot (0.451-0.459) and beats old ridges, while frozen stacked ESMC-6B reaches 0.5485 (0.728 on GBA1, 0.669 on ARAF activity). Under FLIP2's stronger extrapolation shift, ConFit LoRA ESMC (0.310-0.334) trails frozen mutation-site/stacked ridges (0.414-0.457).

key_results.benchmark: Controlled 4-arm pilot on amylase/by_mutation (FLIP2) & fgfr2/random (post-cutoff), first 100 queries
key_results.llm_model: Qwen/Qwen3-14B (BF16, direct mode, zero API spend)
key_results.notes: Separates tabular ICL from protein prior: Qwen3-14B has zero biological prior (k0 near 0) and scores identically on plain vs enciphered post-cutoff FGFR2 (+0.404 vs +0.406, reversing cleanly to -0.372 under flipped labels), trailing one-hot ridge, ESMC, and Mythos 5.2.

temporal_cutoff.evidence: Evaluates 6 newly published post-June-2026 MaveDB splits across GBA1 and ARAF (Oct-Nov 2026) alongside FGFR2 (Nov 2026), explicitly rejecting pre-cutoff PRKN (Feb 2026 bioRxiv).

homology_overlap.evidence: Audited pairwise ungapped window identity across all post-cutoff and FLIP2 parents (max 12.5% pairwise among post-cutoff families, <= 16.7% to FLIP2); evaluates both random and position-disjoint splits.

cross_modal_literature_recall.evidence: Pure pLM methods read protein sequences only; Mythos 5.2 comparison uses identical first-100 queries from our controlled FLIP2 experiment.

preprocessing_artifacts.evidence: Verified 0 wild-type mismatches across 25,878 missense rows, verified epoch-0 ConFit parity to 0.0002 against zero-shot masked marginals, guarded reference baseline tables against key overwrite, and reported two-chain pdz3 averaging as a conservative floor.

downstream_oracle_filtering.evidence: Direct continuous variant ranking without candidate filtering.

compute_and_tool_asymmetry.evidence: All methods trained strictly on the exact same 256 labeled variants with fixed recipes and no test peeking; frozen mutsite/stacked ridges run in ~2.4 min (600M) / ~4.4 min (6B) for all 18 splits.

baseline_fairness.evidence: Tests frozen mean-pool, one-hot+ZS, fusion, mutation-site local pooling, 5-fold multi-view stacking, and ConFit KL-anchored LoRA across ESM-2 650M and ESMC 300M/600M/6B with shuffled-label negative controls.

data_and_wetlab_transparency.evidence: All MaveDB URNs, licenses (CC0 / CC BY-SA 4.0), model revisions, negative controls, and paired-bootstrap JSONs recorded.

takeaway: The prior FLIP2 tie between Claude Mythos 5.2 (0.380) and ESMC ridge (0.367) was an artifact of global mean-pooling dilution: extracting mutation-site local embeddings plus zero-shot scores and 5-fold stacking lifts pure frozen ESMC (600M+6B) to 0.4567 on FLIP2 (+0.0768 strictly above Mythos 5.2, 95% CI +0.0279 to +0.1238) and 0.5485 across 6 new post-cutoff GBA1/ARAF splits, while hybridizing with Mythos 5.2 raises the overall peak to 0.4667. ConFit LoRA ESMC helps strongly on single-site post-cutoff DMS (+0.053 to +0.065) but trails frozen local/stacked ridges under FLIP2's heavier distribution shift.
